text.text: The MDS 9250i Multiservice Fabric Switch is an integral part of Cisco's next-generation storage network. The MDS 9250i , a key component of the Cisco Unified Data Center, provides unmatched flexibility with its multi-protocol innovations unlike disparate solutions. The freedom of choice coupled with a single, proven operating system and management enable an evolutionary adoption and consistent SAN and LAN networking operations. In addition to cost-effective multi-protocol connectivity, the MDS 9250i is the single platform providing high-performance SAN Extension solutions together with a rich set of intelligent Storage Services (via licensing) for IO Accelerator (IOA), and Data Mobility Migration (DMM).

text.text: Services on the MDS 9250i: SAN Extension simplifies data protection and business continuance strategies by enabling backup, remote replication, and other disaster-recovery services over WAN distances using open-standards FCIP tunneling. Cisco I/O Accelerator (IOA) provides acceleration for MAN/WAN applications, and wire encryption for backup and replication operations, making disaster recovery and regulatory compliance much easier. Cisco Data Mobility Manager (DMM) provides the ability to easily migrate data from LUN to LUN or array to array, quickly and without disruption of access to the data.

Services on the MDS 9250i:
SAN Extension simplifies data protection and business continuance strategies by enabling backup, remote replication, and other disaster-recovery services over WAN distances using open-standards FCIP tunneling.
Cisco I/O Accelerator (IOA) provides acceleration for MAN/WAN applications, and wire encryption for backup and replication operations, making disaster recovery and regulatory compliance much easier.
Cisco Data Mobility Manager (DMM) provides the ability to easily migrate data from LUN to LUN or array to array, quickly and without disruption of access to the data.

text.text: The MDS 9250i includes two ports of 1/10 GigabitEthernet for FCIP and Small Computer System Interface over IP (iSCSI) storage services.

text.text: The MDS 9250i scales up to 40 ports of 16-Gbps line-rate Fibre Channel/FICON. The base configuration comes with 20 ports of 16-Gbps Fibre Channel enabled for high-performance SAN connectivity, and it can be upgraded onsite to enable additional 20 ports of 16-Gbps Fibre Channel.

text.text: The MDS 9250i supports multitiered unified network fabric connectivity over eight 10 GigabitEthernet FCoE ports that enable the platform to attach to directly connected FCoE storage. FCoE enables the consolidation of LAN and SAN networks into a single high-performance network over lossless Ethernet, therefore reducing the TCO of server network adapters, cables, and switches while improving operations agility.
